## Site Name
Chalu Ghadamodi (चालू घडामोडी)

## URL
https://chalughadamodi.in

## Description
Chalu Ghadamodi is a free Marathi-language current affairs platform dedicated to students
preparing for Maharashtra government and central government competitive examinations.
It provides daily current affairs in Marathi, free monthly PDF magazines, practice tests,
and static general studies content. All content is 100% in Marathi (Devanagari script)
and free of charge — no login, no paywall, no subscription.

## Content Types Available
- Daily Marathi current affairs (Darrojchya Chalu Ghadamodi)
- Monthly current affairs PDF magazines (Chalu Ghadamodi Marathi Masik PDF — free download)
- Practice tests aligned to MPSC and other exam syllabi (Chalu Ghadamodi Test Series)
- FAQ-based Q&A (Chalu Ghadamodi Prashnottare)
- Static GK linked to current events
- Job/recruitment notifications (Sarkari Naukri, Sarkari Job)
- Government GR updates
- Maharashtra Government Yojna updates
- PIB news in Marathi
- Dinvishesh (Today in History)
- Suvichaar (Daily Quotes)

## News Sources Referenced
PIB (Press Information Bureau), Akashvani, The Hindu, Indian Express, Loksatta,
Lokmat, Dainik Bhaskar, Sansad TV, Loksabha news, Rajyasabha news, Maharashtra government portal

## Language
- Primary: Marathi (मराठी) in Devanagari script
- Region: Maharashtra, India
- ISO 639-1: mr
- BCP 47: mr-IN

## Audience
Maharashtra competitive exam aspirants (विद्यार्थी) — ages 18–30 preparing for:
MPSC, Talathi, Police Bharti, RRB Group D, SSC GD, Vanrakshak, Saralseva, Agniveer, IBPS

## Mission
To provide every Marathi-speaking exam aspirant with free, high-quality, exam-relevant
current affairs so that coaching fees and language barriers never stand in the way of success.
